# OUTCOME-650: Quiet guard: capacity history, reserve alert and changed directories at near-zero idle cost

## Goal

The always-on scanner is gone; the app keeps a durable capacity history, alerts once when free space crosses below the user's reserve, and lists which directories changed in any window, while idle CPU stays below 0.5% of a core. The legacy store is preserved read-only.

## Deliverables

- Quiet guard: capacity history, reserve alert and changed directories at near-zero idle cost
